subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory_search get a non-zero periodic sync fallback by default, or should periodic sync remain opt-in with docs or doctor guidance?
rationale: The source bug is real, but the leading fix changes default fallback behavior and can affect existing users' background work and provider usage, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Default-on fallback after repair
options.body: Accept a 30-minute default only after the linked PR scopes dirty marking correctly and includes upgrade proof for existing users.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Preserve the 0 default and use docs, status, or doctor guidance to steer affected long-running gateways to intervalMinutes manually.

options.title: Watcher health without default change
options.body: Add watcher warning or recovery behavior while leaving interval sync opt-in, trading less background work for weaker stale-index recovery.

recommendation.title: Default-on fallback after repair
recommendation.body: Accept a 30-minute default only after the linked PR scopes dirty marking correctly and includes upgrade proof for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a config/default product tradeoff, and recent history shows memory-search config and timer maintenance on this surface.
